query: United States Japan automobile tariffs trade agreement updates

statements.text: The agreement will reduce US tariffs on Japanese automobiles and parts from 25% (Section 232 auto tariff) to 15% starting within seven days of the publication of the EO in the Federal Register (approximately by September 17).
In 2025, Trump imposed 25% tariffs on vehicles and auto parts
the United States imposed a 15% tariff on most imports from Japan, a reduction from the 25% that President Trump initially proposed but an increase from 2024 U.S. tariff rates.

Under the Agreement, the United States will apply a baseline 15 percent tariff on nearly all Japanese imports entering the United States, alongside separate sector-specific treatment for automobiles and automobile parts
Japan ($69 billion in 2024), which was to face a 25% country-specific tariff.
On July 22, President Trump announced that the United States and Japan had reached a bilateral trade agreement.

Reciprocal tariffs will incorporate the Most Favored Nation (MFN) rate (i.e., general rate of duty applied to Japanese products) and be retroactive to August 7. This rate is set at a flat 15% rate for all products with an MFN of lower than 15%

On July 22, 2025, I announced a framework agreement between the United States and Japan (Agreement), which lays the foundation for a new era of United States-Japan trade relations grounded in principles of reciprocity and our shared national interests.
